purpose: Preserve how a team reached decisions, who owns the next action and where the evidence lives.

story.origin_narrative: Brand positioning story, not a claim about company founding history. Most organizations preserve files and lose the reasons. The Living Archive is built around the small human question every handoff asks: why did we do it this way?
story.core_belief: Continuity is something a team can design.

signature_phrase: Keep the reason, not just the record.

personality.tone: thoughtful, enduring, humane; purposeful without nostalgia
principles: Rights and retention are part of the design
Document provenance and acceptance before implementation

design_system.typography: bookish serif headline with precise metadata typography
design_system.motif: overlapping rings, archival stamps and provenance threads

relationship.parent_visibility: Small endorsement after the individual product story; never replace product identity
relationship.payment: Original exact-price Systemia Stripe checkout only; no rebranding of Stripe product without separate approval

governance.visual_identity_direction: Custom CSS motif; not a registered logo or legal mark

assets.usage: Emblem and palette are original working design directions. Not trademark cleared and not proof of external publication.
